newsitem.title: FRANCE: France raises 96 grain crop estimate to 61.88 mln.
newsitem.headline: France raises 96 grain crop estimate to 61.88 mln.

text.p: The French farm ministry said on Friday it raised its estimate for the national 1996 grain crop to 61.88 million tonnes from a previous target of 61.55 million tonnes.
This would compare with a 1995 grain harvest of 53.55 million tonnes.
In its latest estimate as of November 1 the ministry raised its forecast for the 1996 soft wheat crop to 34.63 million tonnes from the 34.57 million forecast last month.
France produced 29.85 million tonnes of soft wheat in 1995.
The ministry also raised its forecast for the 1996 barley crop to 9.45 million tonnes from last month's forecast of 9.38 million and 7.69 million produced in 1995.
It also revised upwards its estimate for the 1996 maize crop to 13.97 million tonnes from a previous target of 13.78 million and 12.74 million produced in 1995.
